about: Due-date golden cases for FY 2026-27 plus the FY 2025-26 returns still open in 2026. Input names a due-date rule, the last day of the return period and, where the law needs it, the GSTIN state code or the advance-tax instalment. Expected dates are statements of law typed from the cited provisions, never computed, and await advisor CA sign-off. No due date moves for a weekend or holiday; only a notified extension moves one.
